name: AntarChile S.A.
summary: AntarChile S.A. invests in forestry, food and fishing, energy, and other sectors in internationally. The company offers forest products, including pulp, panels, and sawn wood products; distributes distribution of liquid fuels, lubricants, liquefied gas and natural gas; and produce fishmeal and fish oil, preserves, frozen and Omega-3 concentrates. It also produces and sells protein foods of marine, and plant origin; and operates copper mines. AntarChile S.A. was founded in 1984 and is based in Santiago, Chile. AntarChile S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Inversiones Angelini y Compañía Limitada.
